description: Adds basis-refinement seed candidates to split general unresolved status, claim non-closure, and negated collusion status. Preserves the unit-total principle: early and mature active shapes both sum to 1 while dimensions subdivide the whole.

entries.text: The claim remains unresolved because the record has not yet provided enough evidence either way.
entries.literal_meaning: The claim is still unresolved because the evidence is not enough to support or contradict it.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: General unresolved status should mean open evidential status, not claim closure or negated collusion.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Unresolved status is legitimate when the evidence does not yet support or contradict the exact claim.

evidence_burden: Check whether the record supports it.
Check whether the record contradicts it.
Do not turn unresolved status into falsehood or closure.

expected_kernel_response.lexical_action: treat unresolved as general open evidential status
expected_kernel_response.source_trust_action: withhold belief movement until support or contradiction is mapped
questions: What evidence would support or contradict the exact claim?

entries.text: The evidence gap leaves the claim unresolved without proving the claim false.
entries.literal_meaning: An evidence gap keeps a claim unresolved but does not by itself prove the claim false.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: Unresolved status should block truth and falsity movement until evidence direction is known.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: An evidence gap can leave a claim unresolved without supporting a falsehood conclusion.

evidence_burden: Separate absence of support from contradiction.
Do not infer falsehood from unresolved status alone.

questions: Is the record merely incomplete, or does it directly contradict the claim?

entries.text: The question is not settled because the evidence chain has not closed the claim.
entries.literal_meaning: The claim is not settled because the evidence chain has not closed it.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: Not-settled status is specifically a closure boundary, not merely generic uncertainty.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Not-settled status is legitimate when the claim has not met the closure condition for support or contradiction.

evidence_burden: Check whether the evidence chain closes the exact claim.

expected_kernel_response.lexical_action: treat not-settled as a claim-closure boundary
expected_kernel_response.source_trust_action: do not close the question until the evidence chain closes it
questions: What evidence chain would settle this claim?

entries.text: The expert comment leaves the claim not settled until the record closes the question.
entries.literal_meaning: Expert comment does not settle the claim until the record closes it.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: Not-settled status blocks authority-to-closure transfer until record support or contradiction is shown.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Expert status does not settle the claim unless the record closes the exact claim.

evidence_burden: Check whether the record closes the claim rather than relying on authority status.

expected_kernel_response.source_trust_action: keep claim not settled until record closure exists
questions: Does the record close the question, or only an expert comment?

entries.text: The public coordination is not collusion unless a covert agreement is shown.
entries.literal_meaning: Public coordination should not be treated as collusion unless covert agreement evidence is shown.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: Not-collusion status is a negated collusion boundary tied to absence of covert agreement evidence, not generic unresolved status.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Not-collusion contrast is legitimate when the evidence shows public coordination but no covert agreement or illicit control channel.

evidence_burden: Identify whether covert agreement evidence exists.
Do not infer collusion without covert agreement evidence.

expected_kernel_response.lexical_action: treat not-collusion as a negated collusion boundary
expected_kernel_response.source_trust_action: require covert agreement evidence before collusion pressure
questions: Was there a covert agreement, or only public coordination?

entries.text: Similar timing does not show collusion unless it links to a hidden agreement.
entries.literal_meaning: Similar timing does not establish collusion unless it links to a hidden agreement.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: Not-collusion status blocks timing-to-collusion movement unless hidden agreement evidence appears.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: Timing similarity alone does not establish collusion without a hidden agreement or control channel.

evidence_burden: Identify any hidden agreement before moving toward collusion.

questions: Does similar timing link to a hidden agreement?

entries.text: The early status model can be complete as one uncertainty shape, then mature by splitting that one into role-specific dimensions.
entries.literal_meaning: A simple model can be complete at one level, then mature by subdividing the same total into better roles.
entries.candidate_intended_meaning: Unit-total refinement preserves the whole while increasing resolution.

semantic_operators.legitimacy_condition: A refined shape may add dimensions only by redistributing the same active total rather than exceeding one.

evidence_burden: Preserve the parent total as one while subdividing its internal roles.

expected_kernel_response.lexical_action: preserve parent total while refining dimensions
expected_kernel_response.source_trust_action: treat dimension names as local metadata until invariant structure stabilizes
questions: Which child dimensions divide the parent one without exceeding it?
